The speculation that the channeling gene causes the myddraal is interesting, and would explain how they can sense channeling. Curiously their ability to sense channeling isn't mentioned.[[Special:Contributions/74.139.195.33|74.139.195.33]] 12:23, June 6, 2014 (UTC)
